entities.name: Hossein Ali Beg Bayat
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hossein Ali Beg Bayat was a Safavid diplomat who served as the ambassador to the Holy Roman Empire, the Russian Tsardom, Habsburg Spain and several other royal and noble courts during the reign of king Abbas I, and was part of the first Safavid embassy to Europe.
